name: Hungry Robin 21
author: AIVIIID
description: Rounded yellow checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: Clicking it toggles it: background changes from #000000 to #000000, box-shadow becomes -10px -10px 20px 0px #FFD700, 0 -10px 20px 0px #FFD700, 10px -10px 20px 0px #FFD700, 10px 0 20px 0px #FFD700, 10px 10px 20px 0px #FFD700, 0 10px 20px 0px #FFD700, -10px 10px 20px 0px #FFD700, starts the checkmark animation (pulsing, rotating).
